bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to human services; appropriating money for school-linked behavioral health grants.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; SCHOOL-LINKED BEHAVIORAL HEALTH GRANTS. +]

[+$....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for school-linked behavioral health grants under Minnesota Statutes, section 245.4901. Of these amounts, $....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 must be used for grants to increase access to mental health and substance use disorder treatment and services for families of children receiving services through school-linked behavioral health providers. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to human services; appropriating money for school-linked behavioral health grants.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; SCHOOL-LINKED BEHAVIORAL HEALTH GRANTS.

$....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for school-linked behavioral health grants under Minnesota Statutes, section 245.4901. Of these amounts, $....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 must be used for grants to increase access to mental health and substance use disorder treatment and services for families of children receiving services through school-linked behavioral health providers.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
